$comment: Endpoints of services the pipeline talks to. EDIT HERE — no code change, no rebuild. Each entry is overridable at runtime by its env var, so a machine running a service on a different port needs no edit at all. Ports were previously written into 20+ code sites, so moving one meant finding every copy.

dashboard.description: agent-monitor dashboard (nginx container serving live run logs)

langfuse.description: LLM tracing — the observability preflight aborts a run when this is not serving

grafana.description: metrics dashboards — also checked by the observability preflight

storyApi.description: story status API used by operator curl examples

phaseGraph.description: graph browser for the phase dependency graph

remoteSession.description: remote session store for QR-based mobile handoff
